purpose: Common contract of the review mechanism: round flow, handoff between body and agents, finding_id numbering, write and exit values, body duties, and data structures, so findings and evaluations arrive intact.
summary: Terms recognized by the review body, such as review_id, round_number, finding, evaluation, disposition
Review flow sequence with reviewer, evaluator and body per round
Definitions carry script usage and field handling (FNC-314)
Handoff only by review_id and round_number; scripts build and publish inputs; values pass unaltered (FNC-302 to FNC-305, FNC-317)
finding_id numbering by script as one sequence shared by reviewer and evaluator (FNC-313)
Write after decisions are finalized; exit value string expresses success or error (FNC-310, FNC-311, FNC-203)
Body duties: progress rounds, branch on retains_context, termination conditions, final decision authority (FNC-312, FNC-316, FNC-318)
Data models: request, result, finding, evaluation, and absolute path and location notation (DM-301 to DM-305, DM-201)
tasks: Implementing or modifying the review skill body
Modifying reviewer or evaluator agent exchange scripts
Defining exit values and error handling for agents
Changing request or result JSON structures
Reviewing requirement documents on the review mechanism
title: REQ-029 review 機構の共通契約 要件定義書
